t: Teacher guidelines for building a step counting pedometer with a micro:bit or Pico W.
steps: Find the IoT4schools Pedometer projects teacher guidelines on the Erasmus+ project site.
Expect a certificate error on the project server and ask IT before you continue.
Decide on micro:bit boards or Raspberry Pi Pico W boards.
Confirm the programming environment with the guidelines.
Build one pedometer yourself before class.
Walk a measured distance and compare the count to the real steps.
Plan the build, test, and optimize stages for your class.
